accepted_answers.name: pandas
accepted_answers.why: Default tabular engine: vectorised ops, groupby/joins, CSV/Parquet I/O; the lingua franca of tabular Python.

accepted_answers.name: polars
accepted_answers.why: Accepted (increasingly preferred) for speed and memory: multithreaded Rust engine, lazy evaluation.

notes: Strong consensus. Nested-list loops are orders of magnitude slower and reimplement groupby/join badly. Only caveat is which frame library; both are accepted.
problem: Doing dataframe-style tabular operations in Python with nested lists and manual loops.
